# Aunt Josephine

deceased

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Anne-girl P28](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Family:** [Diana](../character/diana.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Aunt Josephine is a thin, prim, and rigid woman. She wears gold-rimmed glasses, through which her eyes snap when she is displeased.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077)_

## Personality

Aunt Josephine is known for her strict and formal demeanor. She maintains a prim and proper attitude, frequently scolding others when her high standards are not met.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)_

## Traits

## History

Aunt Josephine was the wealthy great-aunt of [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) who lived at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). During a visit to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), she was infuriated when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) accidentally jumped on top of her in the spare-room bed, but she was so won over by Anne's brave, sincere apology that she decided to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and became firm friends with her. She later sent [Anne](../character/anne.md) kid slippers for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) and hosted [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) at her estate for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). After enduring a dreadful illness that lasted over a year, Aunt Josephine passed away, leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) a legacy of one thousand dollars in her will to secure her college education.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P2](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Quotes

> “I’m afraid my imagination is a little rusty—it’s so long since I used it,” she said. “I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself.”
>
> — Aunt Josephine — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> “I’ve made up my mind to stay simply for the sake of getting better acquainted with that Anne-girl,” she said frankly. “She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity.”
>
> — Aunt Josephine — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Aunt Josephine — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Aunt Josephine — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Aunt Josephine — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

## Relationships

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

Aunt Josephine is Diana's wealthy grand-aunt who occasionally visits her family at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Their relationship is initially strained when [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally jump onto Aunt Josephine in a dark guest bed, furious at the disruption. However, Aunt Josephine remains fond of her grand-niece, sending her and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gifts like kid slippers for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) and inviting them to stay at her [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) mansion, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI.
